agent.finish_summary: Fixed inverted regex/escape logic in MultiReplace.__init__ in boltons/strutils.py. Previously, when regex=False, the substitution string was used unescaped (treating it as a regex), and when regex=True, it was escaped (breaking regex patterns) - exactly backwards. Swapped the branches: now regex=False -> re.escape(vals[0]) (literal match), regex=True -> vals[0] (used as regex). Verified manually: multi_replace('The mor kedi ate a jelly bean', {'jelly bean': 'dinglehopper'}) now correctly returns 'The mor kedi ate a dinglehopper'; list-based substitutions, regex-flagged compiled patterns, and literal strings containing regex special characters (e.g. '.') all now behave correctly.
